title: reconcile-report.json
description: Machine-readable audit artifact emitted by 'issue-to-project reconcile'. Written to specs/{slug}/reconcile-report.json (slug-scoped runs) or specs/.reconcile-report.json (union/slug-less runs). schema_version '1' = v2.2.0 initial reconcile artifact. project-sync.json is a separate artifact and is never touched by the reconcile path.

schema_version.description: Schema version of this reconcile-report artifact. '1' = v2.2.0.

reconcile_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when reconcile ran.

skill_version.description: The issue-to-project skill version that produced this artifact.

mode.description: The reconcile mode: read_only (no mutations), repair_additive (sync_gap only), or repair_aggressive (all repairable drift; labels win).

slug_scope.description: The feature slug this run was scoped to, or '*' for a union (slug-less) run.

total_board_items.description: Total number of items in the board snapshot after the paged loop completed.

issues_in_input.description: Number of issues from created-issues.json (deduplicated) in this run's scope.

board_items_inspected.description: Total board items from the paged snapshot.

clean.description: Issues in input that are on the board with no detectable drift.

drift_total.description: Total number of drift rows (sum of all by_case values).

label_ready_board_not.description: Label says Ready but board shows something else and the item is not externally pinned. (v2.7.0+)

label_in_review_board_not.description: Label says In review but board shows something else and the item is not externally pinned. (v2.7.0+)

label_pr_drift.description: Issue has PR label but no open linked PR found, or vice-versa. (v2.7.0+)

repaired.description: Number of drift rows where a repair mutation succeeded.

repair_skipped.description: Number of drift rows where repair was not attempted (orphan, pending_future_feature, or drift case not repairable in the active mode).

drift.description: Per-issue drift rows. Empty array when no drift is detected.

severity.description: Default severity: orphan/sync_gap/label_blocked_board_not/board_blocked_label_not = warn; pr_merged_not_done/field_disagrees = error (reported as pending_future_feature/info until those features ship); pending_future_feature = info.

project_item_id.description: GitHub Projects v2 item ID (PVTI_...) if the item is on the board; null for sync_gap rows.

board_status.description: Current board Status option name (e.g. 'Todo', 'In Progress', 'Blocked', 'Done'); null for sync_gap rows.

input_labels.description: Labels from created-issues.json for this issue; null for orphan rows (not in any input file).

note.description: Human-readable explanation of the drift case.

repaired.description: True if a repair mutation succeeded for this row in this run.

repair_action.description: The repair action taken or that would have been taken (DRY_RUN=1): literal gh command or short label. Null if not repairable or not in a repair mode.

orphans_for_review.description: URLs of board items not found in any created-issues.json for this scope. These require manual review — the skill never auto-deletes board items.
